game_title: Loop Counter Conveyor – Stalactite Hall Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Stalactite Hall, a hall of dripping stalactites: the lantern keeper must handle slime blobs while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Loop Counter Conveyor: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed.
theme: Shadow Cave – Stalactite Hall: a hall of dripping stalactites
core_gameplay_loop: In Stalactite Hall, repeat each round: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the belt_count value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the cave gate using at most 20 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The cave gate reached with actions_used <= 20.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 20 before the cave gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 5 (applied tier): Loop Counter Conveyor
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
